comment: Hand-maintained corrections applied by snapshot.mjs on top of json.tarkov.dev, for quest data the API has not caught up on. EFT 1.1 moved these Ragman quests to loyalty-level gating and reworked several objectives; the wiki-rename pass (wikiRenames.mjs) already heals their titles, but the API still reports pre-1.1 player levels, prerequisites, objectives, and XP. Each entry patches the task with the matching id and self-retires once the API reports minPlayerLevel at or below retireWhenApiMinPlayerLevelAtMost - at that point delete the entry. Sources: escapefromtarkov.fandom.com pages listed per entry, cross-checked against in-game 1.1.0.0 PvE (2026-08-06).

overrides.note: 'Database - Part 2', now 'A Big Loss': LL1 Ragman, no prerequisite (old prereq 'Database - Part 1' no longer applies - in-game it is active without it), XP 8500 -> 3000.

'The Blood of War - Part 1', now 'Fuel Crisis': LL1 Ragman, no prerequisites, objectives reworked from 4 fixed tanks to 2 area marks. Points kept from the old objectives as candidate tank locations (power station tank verified against the old guide; the two northern points are best guesses).

objectives.description: Locate and mark any fuel tank near the power station with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark any fuel tank in the northern territory with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange

overrides.note: 'Sales Night', now 'Pathfinder': LL1 Ragman, no prerequisite (in-game it is completed while its wiki-listed prereq 'Gratitude' is still active). Objectives reworked from survive-and-extract to visiting three exits; points taken from the snapshot's Interchange extract positions.

objectives.description: Visit the Railway Exfil exit on Interchange
Visit the Emercom Checkpoint exit on Interchange
Visit the Power Station V-Ex exit on Interchange

overrides.note: 'The Blood of War - Part 3', now 'Small Things, Big Help': LL1 Ragman, no prerequisite (in-game it is active while 'The Blood of War - Part 2' is not completed). Objectives unchanged.
'Gratitude': 1.1 moved it to Ragman LL1; in-game it is active at player level 7 alongside its old prereqs ('Dressed to Kill', 'Database - Part 2'), so both gates are stale.
'Dressed to Kill': 1.1 moved it to Ragman LL1. Its prereq 'The Blood of War - Part 1' (now 'Fuel Crisis') is kept: the wiki still lists it and it is consistent with the in-game state.

'Long Line': 1.1 reworked it into a Ragman LL1 quest - eliminate 4 PMCs anywhere on Interchange (was 20 inside the mall at level 45, prereq 'Supervisor'), XP 84000 -> 3000, no longer Kappa-required. Old in-mall points dropped since the kills now count map-wide.

'Blood in the Water': in-game (1.1.0.0 PvE, level 7, Therapist LL1, only 'First in Line' done) it is active alongside 'Operation Aquarius', so the API's chain (requires Operation Aquarius complete) is stale; the 1.1 starter set chains behind 'First in Line' only.
'Operation Aquarius': same in-game evidence - active alongside 'Shortage', so the API's chain (requires Shortage complete) is stale.
'Supply Plans': active in-game at level 7 Therapist LL1 with only 'First in Line' done; the API/wiki level 13 and the 'Pharmacist' prerequisite are both stale.

'Big Sale': not offered on the in-game Ragman LL1 board (1.1.0.0 PvE, level 7, 2026-08-06) although the wiki documents no gate and the API prereq ('Only Business') was removed from the game. Best supported reading: LL2. Revisit when the wiki adds a requirements line.
'Break the Deal': same situation as Big Sale - absent from the in-game Ragman LL1 board with no wiki-documented gate. Best supported reading: LL2.
'Make ULTRA Great Again': 1.1 reworked it into a Ragman LL1 quest - eliminate 10 any targets on Interchange (was 25 Scavs at level 15, prereq 'Only Business'), XP 9800 -> 3000.
